info.title: 1club Platform API
info.description:
The 1club Platform API lets you programmatically access and manage your organization's data.

## Official API Contract

This documentation is the official source of truth for the 1club Platform API.
If an integration relies on undocumented endpoints, fields, response shapes, or internal behavior outside this spec, we can't guarantee backward compatibility.
Build against what's documented here to stay stable as the platform evolves.

## Authentication

All requests require a customer API key passed as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer 1club_sk_live_...
```

Generate API keys from the admin portal under **Settings > API Tokens**.
The key is tied to your organization - all responses are scoped to your org's data.

Agents and MCP connectors can instead send an OAuth access token (the `platformOAuth` scheme), requesting only the scopes the task needs.

## Rate Limiting

- **100 requests per minute** per API key
- When exceeded, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header
- Rate limit headers are included in every response:
  - `X-RateLimit-Limit` - max requests per window
  - `X-RateLimit-Remaining` - requests remaining
  - `X-RateLimit-Reset` - seconds until the window resets

## Errors

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `400` | Invalid request parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid API key |
| `404` | Resource not found (or doesn't belong to your organization) |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `500` | Internal server error |

## Versioning and deprecation

The API is versioned in the path (`/v1`). Changes within a version are additive: new endpoints, new optional parameters and new response fields can appear at any time, so clients should ignore fields they do not recognise.
A breaking change ships as a new version.
An operation due to be removed is first marked `deprecated: true` in this spec and announced in the changelog at https://docs.1club.ai/changelog, with advance notice before it is withdrawn.

customerApiAuth.description: Organization-scoped bearer credential: a customer API key (1club_sk_live_...) or an MCP OAuth access token.

platformOAuth.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE (S256), as used by MCP connectors. Register a client dynamically (RFC 7591) at https://api.1club.ai/v1/mcp/oauth/register. Each scope grants one capability; request only what the integration needs.

scopes.*: Full access - read and manage everything in this organization, including capabilities added later
scopes.classes:read: View classes, class types, schedules and progression tracks
scopes.classes:write: Create, reschedule, and cancel classes, and maintain the class types they are run as
scopes.checkins:write: Check people in, to a booking or on their membership
scopes.content:write: Create, edit and delete content - posts, FAQs, documents and reusable blocks
scopes.website:read: View your website: pages, sections, layout, styles and publish history
scopes.website:write: Edit your website - pages, sections, navigation and styles. Edits stay unpublished until published.
scopes.website:publish: Publish your website, making unpublished edits visible to the public, and roll back to an earlier version
scopes.media:write: Add images and videos to your media library and edit their names and descriptions
scopes.media:delete: Permanently delete files from your media library
scopes.clubs:write: Edit your clubs' details - name, contact details, address, opening hours, amenities and sports. Live on your website, member portal, app and 1club.me at once; a club listed on 1club.me sends its listing's changes for review.
scopes.transactions:read: View transactions, revenue reports and your chart of accounts
scopes.transactions:write: Record revenue collected outside 1club, such as a marketplace payout for your bookings, and refunds of it. Nothing is charged to anyone.
scopes.transactions:delete: Void unpaid charges so they are no longer owed, and delete ones raised by mistake. A never-paid pass whose last charge goes is cancelled with it. Paid charges cannot be voided or deleted, and an API key reaches only the charges of bookings it made.
scopes.invoices:read: View your invoices - who they were issued to, their amounts and status - and how much was invoiced over a period
scopes.areas:read: View areas, area types, blocks and availability
scopes.areas:write: Create and update areas and area types, and block or unblock an area
scopes.bookings:write: Create, change, reschedule and cancel bookings, and add or remove participants
scopes.bookings:delete: Permanently delete bookings entered by mistake, with their unpaid charges, check-ins and players. A paid or invoiced booking cannot be deleted - cancel and refund it instead.
scopes.contacts:read: View contacts, their tags and custom field values, and your sales pipeline stages and sources
scopes.contacts:write: Create and update contacts and tag them, and maintain your tags, smart tag rules and contact custom fields
scopes.contacts:delete: Archive contacts, which cancels their active memberships and all their future bookings. Separate from creating and updating because those cancellations are not undone by restoring the contact.
scopes.instructors:read: View instructors, their availability, the staff roster and their time off
scopes.instructors:write: Create and update instructors (coaches) and the instructor types they are grouped by, including what members pay for a one-to-one session and how you pay the coach, and manage the staff roster (shifts, rotations) and their time off. Does not grant admin-portal access: an instructor created this way has no login and is never invited to your staff portal.
scopes.plans:write: Create, edit and delete plans and plan categories
scopes.memberships:write: Sell memberships, set their price and whether they are paid, and pause, resume or cancel them
scopes.products:read: View the product catalogue and its categories, including prices and how many are left to sell
scopes.products:write: Create and edit products and product categories
scopes.forms:read: View your forms and their questions, and how many people have completed each. Not the answers themselves.
scopes.forms:write: Create and edit forms and their questions, including sign-up forms that sell your plans and products. Forms are public as soon as they are created or changed. Does not delete forms.
scopes.organization:write: Change organization-wide settings, which take effect immediately. That includes which languages you offer, across your website, the member portal, the mobile app and email, and what your clubs call their booking cards (private training, group activities, areas) wherever members book.
scopes.revenue-accounts:write: Add accounts to your chart of accounts and edit them, including which one sales post to by default. Reading the chart needs no scope of its own - any of plans, products or transactions admits it.
scopes.pricing-rules:read: View pricing rules - the surcharges, discounts and set prices applied when a booking is priced - and quote what a booking would cost
scopes.pricing-rules:write: Create, edit, turn off and delete pricing rules. Changes apply to every booking priced afterwards.
scopes.booking-policies:read: View booking policies: cancellation and refund rules, payment timing and booking windows
scopes.booking-policies:write: Create, edit, duplicate and delete booking policies. Changes apply to every booking they cover from then on.
scopes.document-rules:read: View document rules - which members are asked to sign or accept which documents, such as waivers
scopes.document-rules:write: Create, edit and delete document rules, which decide who must sign or accept a document and whether it is required for entry
scopes.external-programs:read: View external programs - third parties such as MultiSport or a corporate wellness scheme that pay for members' visits - and what each covers
scopes.external-programs:write: Create, edit and remove external programs, including what each pays per visit and which classes, areas and coaches it can be used for
scopes.templates:read: View your email and SMS templates
scopes.templates:write: Create, edit and delete email and SMS templates
scopes.events:read: View events, their tickets and how many are sold
scopes.events:write: Create, edit, duplicate and delete events, and publish, unpublish or cancel them. Cancelling an event also cancels its attendees' bookings.
scopes.messages:read: View messages sent to and received from your members, and their delivery status
scopes.messages:write: Prepare draft messages to members. Drafts are never sent from here: someone at your club reviews and sends them from 1club.
scopes.analytics:read: View statistics over a period - revenue, bookings, check-ins, how full your classes, courts and coaches were, memberships added and cancelled, and new members - as totals, never the people or sales behind them
scopes.payment-methods:write: Add, rename and remove the payment methods staff record by hand, such as cash or a bank transfer, and choose which ones members may pick when paying for a booking. Reading them needs no scope of its own - transactions:read admits it.
scopes.staff:read: View your staff accounts, their roles, and what each role is allowed to do
scopes.staff:write: Change a staff member's role, and what the manager, front desk and instructor roles are allowed to do. Only a signed-in person can use it, with the same limits as in 1club: an API key is always refused.
scopes.notifications:read: View which notifications each role gets by default, and on which channels
scopes.notifications:write: Change which notifications each role gets and on which channels, and apply those defaults to everyone in a role, replacing their own choices
scopes.competitors:read: View the competitors you follow, their prices and Google ratings, and how your prices compare with the market
scopes.competitors:write: Add, edit and remove the competitors you follow, and have their websites read again
scopes.promotions:read: View your promotions - discounts and vouchers, their promo codes, dates and how often they were redeemed

instructorLocationId.description: Where the class happens, when that is one of its instructors' locations (GET /v1/platform/instructors/{id} `locations`) rather than an area of its club. Required for a Professional's class (`INSTRUCTOR_LOCATION_REQUIRED`), whose club is its business and not a place. The class then takes no `areaId`.

priceBeforeTax.description: The price to store, excluding tax - the same field reads return. The tax-inclusive `price` a class reads back with is computed and cannot be written: sending it is a 400, because posting it back would re-apply tax on every round trip.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 instant with an explicit offset.

endTime.description: ISO 8601 instant with an explicit offset.

recurrence.description: Repeat rule. Present, this one request creates the whole series rather than a single occurrence - `startTime`/`endTime` become the template slot, and the series runs from `startTime`. A bounded series (`ends.type` `until` or `after`) is written in full here and capped at 520 occurrences; an open-ended one materializes a rolling window and extends itself. Unknown fields are rejected.

interval.description: Repeat every N days, weeks or months.

daysOfWeek.description: Required for a weekly cadence, and rejected for any other - nothing else reads it. The first occurrence is the first listed day at or after `startTime`.

endDate.description: Last day the series may reach, as an ISO 8601 instant with an explicit offset; an occurrence starting at or before it is kept. Required when `ends.type` is `until`, and rejected otherwise.

ends.description: How the series terminates. Omitted on a create means `never`: an open-ended series kept on a rolling window.

occurrences.description: How many occurrences the series holds **in total**, counted from its first occurrence and across every day in `daysOfWeek` - not how many weeks. A Monday-and-Wednesday class running for twelve weeks is `24`, not `12`; sending `12` there creates six weeks. When the series ends on a date rather than after a count, `ends.type: "until"` with an `endDate` says so without the arithmetic. Required when `ends.type` is `after`, and rejected otherwise.

notifyCustomer.description: Tell the people booked on this class what changed - email plus the in-app and WhatsApp notification. Only sent when the edit changes something visible on their booking (start/end time, area, club, or the instructors); a rename or a price change notifies nobody. Off by default, so callers normally send their own. Assigned instructors get their calendar update either way.

planCategoryId.description: Category the plan is grouped under on price lists, from GET /v1/platform/plan-categories. `null` takes it out of every category.

revenueAccountId.description: Ledger account a sale of this plan posts to, from GET /v1/platform/revenue-accounts. Leave it out and the sale falls to the organization's default account, resolved at the time of the sale - so omitting this is a choice, not a gap. `null` clears it back to that.

minimumTermMonths.description: Months a buyer commits to before the membership may end, counted from its start; null for none. A membership sold on the plan is stamped with it. Binds only a renewing plan whose first billing period it outlasts - 12 on a yearly plan commits to nothing.

featured.description: Highlight the plan as "Most popular" on the club's price lists. A flag, not a single choice: mark the same tier at each billing period it is sold at.

allowances.description: The plan's session counters, sent instead of `maxUses`, `sessionUnit` and `validFor`: several for a plan like 5 Yoga + 4 Pilates a month. Two allowances may not cover the same type in the same scope, and only one may have no scopes (the one a check-in without a booking spends). On an update, an `id` from the plan's `allowances` keeps that allowance; one left out is removed. A single entry makes an ordinary plan.

id.description: An existing allowance's `allowanceId`, to keep it.

maxUses.description: Sessions it grants each period; null for unlimited.

PlatformInstructor.description: Public instructor shape returned alongside classes.

bio.description: EditorJS document for the instructor bio.

PlatformClass.description: One class occurrence. A weekly class materializes a row per session, linked by `recurrenceId` and `occurrenceIndex`, so `id` is what a booking's `classId` points at - and what distinguishes two groups running in the same hour. Read the staff roster with GET /v1/platform/classes/{id}/bookings.

instructorLocationId.description: Where the class happens when that is one of its instructors' locations rather than its club: always set for a Professional's class.

areaId.description: Room or court the class occupies, when one is assigned.

status.description: A cancelled occurrence keeps its bookings and roster.

price.description: Price including the organization's default tax - what a member is charged.

priceBeforeTax.description: The price as stored on the class, before tax.

maxPartySize.description: Largest party one booking may bring, from the class type.

bookedCount.description: Seats taken: attendee bookings plus standalone walk-in check-ins.

spotsLeft.description: `maxCapacity - bookedCount`, floored at 0; null when capacity is unlimited.

recurrenceId.description: The series this occurrence belongs to; null for a one-off class.

occurrenceIndex.description: Position within the series, as materialized.

recurrence.description: The series rule, when this occurrence belongs to one.

instructors.description: Who teaches the occurrence. The instructor's own weekly availability is not included; read it from GET /v1/platform/instructors.

externalSource.description: Import provenance - set when the occurrence came from an external system rather than being created in 1club.

externalId.description: The source system's id for this occurrence, for reconciliation against it.

translations.description: Every locale's copy, keyed by language code (e.g. 'es', 'fr'). Returned alongside the `locale`-resolved `name`/`description`, so an integration syncing a multilingual timetable can read all of them in one call.

series.description: Present **only** on the response to a recurring create or to an update that moved where the series ends, never on a read: it describes what that one request did. An occurrence at a club that is closed, or past its closing date, is skipped rather than failing the request, so comparing `occurrencesCreated` with what you asked for is the only way a partially-skipped season is visible.

occurrencesCreated.description: Occurrences written by this request. The whole series for a bounded one; the first window for an open-ended one, which the extension job grows from there.

occurrencesRemoved.description: Occurrences past the new end that this request removed. Only on the response to an end change.

total.description: Total classes matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformClassBooking.description: One attendee of a class occurrence. Class seats are one booking per person, so this is a booking row resolved with the attendee's name, check-in and payment.

contactId.description: Null for an anonymous seat - a pass or a guest ticket sold without naming who would use it. `bookerName` is then who paid for it.

bookerName.description: Who paid, when the seat is anonymous and was sold through an order - so a roster reads "Anonymous (Ivan Petrov)" rather than an opaque booking number.

contactEmail.description: Null unless the key also holds `contacts:read` - an email address is contact PII, gated as it is on the contacts resource.

status.description: Booking status (confirmed, pending, checked_in, cancelled).

source.description: Channel that created it (admin, portal, app, api, kiosk, …).

checkedIn.description: Whether the attendee was checked in.

status.description: Classified exactly as on `PlatformBooking`. A seat covered by a membership or an external program is `no_charge` - it owes nothing even though it carries a price - so do not read it as an outstanding balance.

paidAmount.description: What has been collected on the booking, gross, before any refund. `0` when nothing has.

refundedAmount.description: What has been returned to the customer, across every refund recorded. `paidAmount - refundedAmount` is what the club kept.

reference.description: The collecting partner's own id for the payment, when one reported it through this API (`payment.reference`); null for money 1club collected itself.

fee.description: What the collecting partner kept out of the amount, when it reported one (`payment.fee`).

membershipId.description: The membership the seat was drawn from, when it was covered by one.

entranceMethod.description: How the seat was paid for (direct_payment, membership, external_program).

PlatformClub.description: A club with its address, contact info, amenities, sports, aggregated images, and average rating.

images.description: All images aggregated from the club and its active areas.

amenities.description: Raw amenity IDs stored on the club.

amenitiesResolved.description: Amenities resolved to display objects (id, name, locale-aware).

rating.description: Average and total of public reviews. Omitted when there are no public reviews.

socialProfiles.description: Map of social network keys (e.g. 'instagram') to profile URLs.

subtitle.description: In the requested `locale` when the club has a translation for it.

description.description: The club description as an Editor.js block tree (`{ blocks: [...] }`), its text in the requested `locale` when the club has a translation for it.

gettingThere.description: How to reach the club, in the club's own words. In the requested `locale` when translated.

operatingHours.description: Opening hours per weekday (`monday` … `sunday`), each `{ enabled, openTime, closeTime }` in the club's own clock.

timezone.description: The club's IANA timezone, which `operatingHours` are read in.

privateTrainingLabel.description: The title of the card that sells an hour with a coach. Defaults to the platform's "Private training". Up to 30 characters, on one line. Null when the club uses the platform wording.

groupActivitiesLabel.description: The title of the card that lists the club's classes. Defaults to the platform's "Group activities". Up to 30 characters, on one line. Null when the club uses the platform wording.

areasLabel.description: The title of the card for areas that have no area-type name of their own - untyped areas, and the card that gathers every area. A card for a named area type always shows that type's name instead, so a club whose types are all named never sees this one. Defaults to the platform's "Areas". Up to 30 characters, on one line. Null when the club uses the platform wording.

translations.description: Per-language renderings of the labels, keyed by locale, then by label field. Only the booking-card labels; a member reading in a locale with no entry here sees the label itself.

PlatformClubSummary.description: One of the organization's clubs, as the club list returns it and as a booking-label update answers: who it is, and its own words for the booking cards members choose from under "What would you like to book?".

slug.description: What every other club endpoint takes in its path.

status.description: Only an active club is open for booking; the labels of any club can be set ahead of time.

PlatformClubBookingLabelsUpdate.description: The booking-card labels to change. Send only what changes; an omitted field is left alone, and at least one is required. The change is live as soon as it is saved, on every surface members book from: the website, the member portal, the mobile app and 1club.me. Only the card titles are the club's to word: the line under each card is always the platform's, a count ("4 available") or, under the group activities card, the club's class type names.

privateTrainingLabel.description: The title of the card that sells an hour with a coach. Defaults to the platform's "Private training". Up to 30 characters, on one line. An empty string or null clears it, and members read the platform wording again (already translated into every language 1club ships). Clearing a label also removes its translations.

An empty string or null clears it, and members read the platform wording again (already translated into every language 1club ships). Clearing a label also removes its translations.

A card for a named area type always shows that type's name instead, so a club whose types are all named never sees this one. Defaults to the platform's "Areas". Up to 30 characters, on one line. An empty string or null clears it, and members read the platform wording again (already translated into every language 1club ships). Clearing a label also removes its translations.

translations.description: Per-language renderings of the labels, keyed by locale (`"en"`, `"pt-BR"`), then by label field. Merged into what the club already has: only the locales and fields you send change. A string sets that translation, an empty string or null removes it. A translation needs a label under it - one for a label the club does not set (after this request) is refused, since the card then shows the platform wording, which is translated already. Only the three label fields are accepted here; the club's other translations are never touched.

PostFaq.description: One question of a post's FAQ. Plain text; blank lines separate the answer's paragraphs.

PlatformContent.description: A content item (FAQ, post, document, block, or how-to guide) for the organization.

content.description: Body of the content item. May contain HTML, EditorJS blocks, a summary, and keywords.

faqs.description: A post's questions and answers, shown after its text. Empty for other types.

PlatformMedia.description: An item in the organization's media library. Files are hosted externally (Cloudinary for anything uploaded through the admin editor); this record is the library entry that website sections and content reference by `url`.

url.description: Public URL of the file. Immutable - register a new item to replace a file.

name.description: Display name. Searched, along with altText, when looking an image up by name.

altText.description: Alternative text for screen readers. Also searched.

PlatformWebsiteSection.description: One section of a page or of the site layout. `config` fields depend on `type` - see GET /v1/platform/website/section-types for the definitions.

htmlId.description: The section's anchor on the page (`#<htmlId>`), unique within the page. Send back the value a read returned to keep it; omit it and one is derived from the type.

translations.description: Per-locale overrides for the section's translatable string fields, keyed by locale then field: { "bg": { "headline": "…" } }. Config values themselves stay in the default language.

PlatformWebsitePage.description: A page on the website draft.

slug.description: URL path segment. The homepage is served at "/" regardless of its slug.

sections.description: Present when fetching a single page; omitted from list responses.

noindex.description: True when the page asks search engines not to index it and is left out of `sitemap.xml`.

translations.description: Per-locale `metaTitle`/`metaDescription` overrides, keyed by locale: { "bg": { "metaTitle": "…" } }. Present when fetching a single page.

url.description: The page's public URL once published.

PlatformWebsitePageSeo.description: What the published page will actually put in its `<head>`, after every fallback has been applied - the authored fields alone do not answer "is my SEO right?". Present when fetching a single page. Read-only.

metaTitle.description: The `<title>`, after falling back to the page title.

canonicalUrl.description: The `rel=canonical` the default-locale render emits, locale prefix included.

indexable.description: Whether search engines are asked to index this page.

notIndexableReason.description: Why `indexable` is false. An unpublished or switched-off site is not indexable however the page is configured.

localizedLocales.description: Locales carrying their own metaTitle/metaDescription overrides.

PlatformWebsite.description: A website belonging to the organization. Page content, layout and theme tokens describe the **draft**. `url`, `published`, `activeReleaseVersion` and `lastPublishedAt` describe what the public is currently being served. `name` and `clubId` are live row fields — they take effect without a publish.

slug.description: Platform host label - the site answers on `<slug>.1club.me`.

domain.description: Custom domain, when one is pointed at this site.

isDefault.description: True for the site an organization-wide caller means by "the website". Exactly one per organization.

isActive.description: False means the site is switched off and serves nothing publicly, whatever the draft contains.

clubId.description: Club this website represents. When set, the header and footer use that club's logo instead of the organization's. Live, like `name`.

url.description: Public URL - the custom domain when set, else the platform host.

previewUrl.description: The same site rendered from the unpublished draft - the link to review edits before publishing. Carries a signed grant that expires 24 hours after this response was generated; read the website again for a fresh one. Anyone holding the link can view the draft, so it is shareable without a login but should be treated as sensitive.

published.description: Whether the site has ever been published. False means nothing is publicly reachable yet.

supportedLocales.description: Locales the site serves, which is what its `hreflang` alternates and `sitemap.xml` advertise. Organization-level - see `PATCH /v1/platform/website`.

defaultLocale.description: Locale served at the site root. Organization-level.

seoSettings.description: Site-wide SEO defaults. Each field is a fallback a page can override.

siteDescription.description: Meta-description fallback, and the `description` in the site's structured data.

defaultOgImage.description: Social-share image for pages with no `ogImage` of their own.

verification.description: Search-console ownership tokens, rendered as meta tags on every page.

pages.description: Present when fetching one website; omitted from the site list.

layout.description: Header and footer, rendered on every page.

PlatformWebsiteRelease.description: A published version of the website. The public site renders the release with `isActive: true`.

publishedAt.description: When this release last went live. An ordinary publish amends the active release in place, so this moves while `createdAt` does not.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable reason, when the error has one (e.g. `CONTACT_EXISTS`).

details.description: Structured values behind the error. A 409 naming an existing record carries its id here, e.g. `contactId`.

WebsiteSectionFieldCondition.description: When a field is relevant, as a comparison against a SIBLING field of the same section. Deliberately data rather than an expression, and deliberately unable to reach platform data or anything resolved at render time, so the server, the editor and a model all answer it the same way. Exactly one form per object.

field.description: The sibling field this condition reads. Always resolves before the field carrying the condition.

equals.description: Relevant when the sibling equals this value.

oneOf.description: Relevant when the sibling is one of these values.

isEmpty.description: Relevant when the sibling is (true) or is not (false) unset, blank or an empty array.

WebsiteSectionField.description: One config field of a website section. This is the ONLY description of the field: its control, its value space, where it belongs in an editor, whether it translates, and when it applies. Nothing about a field is documented elsewhere.

type.description: `header` and `paragraph` store nothing — they structure and explain an editing panel.

defaultValue.description: What a new section starts with. See the catalog's `defaults` for the resolved config.

group.description: Where the admin editor places the field. Advisory and editor-driven: a field may move between groups as the editor changes, so do not key behaviour on it.

order.description: Ascending display order. A conditional field always sorts after the field its condition names.

primary.description: The section’s defining choice - the one that reshapes the whole section, such as a hero’s `variant`. At most one per section type.

translatable.description: Whether this value carries per-locale overrides in the section’s `translations` map.

entityType.description: For `entity` / `entity_list`: which platform record the value references.

itemFields.description: For `object_list`: the shape of one item. Recursive, so a nav item’s dropdown children and a footer link group are declared rather than described in prose.

unit.description: For `range`: the suffix shown beside the value (e.g. "%").

deprecated.description: Superseded: an existing section keeps its value and it still renders, but do not set it on a new section. The type’s `notes` name the replacement.

PlatformIdentity.description: Describes the authorized organization, the scopes granted to the bearer credential, and the catalog of available platform resources.

organization.description: The organization this request acts in. Null only for an MCP connection reaching several organizations, called without the `X-1Club-Organization-Id` header.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the organization trades in (e.g. "EUR"). Every monetary amount on this API - booking `payment.amount`, plan and product prices, transaction totals - is expressed in it, and no other endpoint repeats it. Read it once when you connect.

organizations.description: Every organization the credential may act in: an API key's own, or every organization an MCP connection's user is staff of. A connection reaching several names the one each request acts in with the `X-1Club-Organization-Id` header.

access.description: Only in a `search` by 1club staff: an organization they are not a member of, which they may act in as staff.

unavailable.description: Set only when `organization` is null: a call naming this organization would be refused, for this reason.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the bearer credential - an API key or an MCP OAuth grant - exactly as held (e.g. "classes:read"). A full-access key holds the single wildcard scope "*"; read `effectiveScopes` to see what that resolves to. An MCP grant never holds "*": the wildcard is expanded at consent so each capability can be shown and approved.

fullAccess.description: True when the credential holds the wildcard scope "*", granting every scope including ones added after it was issued.

effectiveScopes.description: The scopes this credential can actually use - identical to `scopes` for a narrow grant, and the full expansion of "*" for a full-access key. Check a capability against this list, not `scopes`.

resources.description: Catalog of resources and the actions each supports.

PlatformTransaction.description: A billing transaction with amounts, payment status, and links to the originating booking or membership.

uuid.description: Stable unguessable identifier. Prefer this over `id` when storing a reference.

transactionType.description: TransactionType enum value (e.g. booking_creation, membership_creation, product_sale, membership_recurrence, etc.). A settlement recorded with `POST /v1/platform/transactions` is `settlement`.

contactId.description: The customer charged, when there is one.

clubId.description: Set on a settlement only; other transactions take their club from their booking or membership.

date.description: The day the charge counts on in every money report: when it was sold, a booking's visit, or the start of the membership period it pays for.

dueDate.description: The day an unpaid charge falls due (midnight UTC naming the calendar day), set only where that is later than `date`: a Season Pass sold ahead is dated at its sale and owed from the day it starts. Null means it is due on `date`.

amount.description: Pre-tax amount as a decimal string (e.g. "25.00"). Serialized as a string to preserve precision.

taxAmount.description: Tax portion as a decimal string.

totalAmount.description: Total billed amount as a decimal string (amount + taxAmount).

PlatformBooking.description: A booking created through the platform API. Recorded with a booking transaction so it counts for revenue, marked paid (settled against a payment method named after the caller's API key, so the club can reconcile what each partner collected) or unpaid (outstanding) per the caller. Collection stays with the caller; what it collected and what it gave back on cancellation are reported in `payment`.

bookingUuid.description: Stable unguessable identifier. Prefer this over `bookingId` when storing a reference.

status.description: Booking status (e.g. confirmed, cancelled)

classId.description: The class occurrence this booking attends, when it is a class booking. Every attendee holds their own booking row against the same `classId`, and `classes` rows are per-occurrence - so this is what tells two classes running in the same hour apart. Join it against GET /v1/platform/classes, or read the staff roster with GET /v1/platform/classes/{id}/bookings.

eventId.description: The event this booking attends, when it is an event booking. Read the attendee list with GET /v1/platform/events/{id}/bookings.

eventTicketId.description: The event ticket the seat was sold on, when the event sells tickets

orderId.description: The order the booking was sold on: one per sale, holding the customer's seat and any guests'. Every class enrolment and event registration made through this API has one; null for a booking sold on none (a court or coach booked through POST /v1/platform/bookings).

seatBookingIds.description: Every seat the sale holds, the customer's own first. Only on the answer to a seat sale (POST /v1/platform/classes/{id}/bookings, POST /v1/platform/events/{id}/bookings); the guests' seats carry no contact, and the class's or the event's roster lists them all.

maxPlayers.description: How many players the booking takes, the organizer included, when it differs from the area type's `defaultMaxPlayers`: `2` on a court booked for singles (area types with `allowsSingles`). `null` means the area type's own limit. Adding a player past it is refused.

instructorId.description: Instructor leading the session, when one is attached

customer.description: The booking's customer, identical to what GET /v1/platform/contacts/{id} returns. Present only when the request passes `include=customer`, which additionally requires the `contacts:read` scope; `null` when the booking has no contact. Use it to import a window of bookings without a contact lookup per row.

money.description: What the booking costs and how it was paid. Present only with `include=money`, which additionally requires the `transactions:read` scope. `billed` is always `paid + outstanding`, on the same basis as the admin's Booking audit: tax-inclusive, net of refunds, so a cancelled booking bills only the Cancellation Charge it kept.

paid.description: Money the club kept: collected, net of refunds.

outstanding.description: Still owed on the booking. A closed charge owes nothing.

paymentState.description: paid, partial, unpaid, refunded, covered or free.

payerContactId.description: Who the charge is on: the organizer, or a player paying their own share.

amount.description: What the charge bills, after any cancellation credit against it.

refundedAmount.description: Returned from its payments by a refund.

credits.description: Cancellation credits: what a cancellation took off a charge.

cancellation.description: The cancellation terms stamped on the booking and how it was cancelled. Present only with `include=cancellation`.

terms.description: The terms the customer accepted with the booking - not the club's policy today, which may since have changed. `null` for an event ticket, whose event keeps its own terms, and for a booking accepted before terms were stamped.

deadlines.description: Every band that refunds something, as the moment to cancel by, widest notice first.

freeCancellationUntil.description: The last moment a cancellation refunds in full; `null` when no band does.

fullyCovered.description: A membership or pass covered the whole booking.

collectsFromWallet.description: The Cancellation Charge is taken from the Wallet.

cancelled.description: `null` while the booking is not cancelled.

noticeHours.description: Hours between the cancellation and the start; negative when it came after the start.

status.description: `no_charge` means there is nothing to collect: either nothing was ever owed (a free area, an amount of 0) or an entitlement covers it - a membership or external program the attendee already holds, which is why a covered booking can carry a price and still owe nothing. `paid` counts every financially closed transaction status (`paid`, `settled`, `refunded`), and every charge type, not only the one this API records.

amount.description: The booking's recorded price in the organization's currency; `status` is what says whether anything was collectable. Where the price is 0 but a real charge exists - an external program's per-visit fee lives entirely in its transaction - the ledger total is reported instead.

paidAmount.description: What has been collected on the booking, gross, before any refund. `0` when nothing has.

refundedAmount.description: What has been returned to the customer, across every refund recorded. `paidAmount - refundedAmount` is what the club kept.

reference.description: The collecting partner's own id for the payment, when one reported it through this API (`payment.reference`); null for money 1club collected itself.

fee.description: What the collecting partner kept out of the amount, when it reported one (`payment.fee`).

PlatformBookingUpdate.description: An edit to a booking. Every field is optional; send only what changes. A body with nothing but `notifyCustomer` is refused.

startTime.description: New start. With `scope=all_future`, every later occurrence takes this time of day on its own date; change the weekday with `recurrence.daysOfWeek`.

endTime.description: New end. Must be after the start, stored or sent.

areaId.description: Move the booking to this area (from GET /v1/platform/areas). Must be an area this API can sell, as on create.

instructorId.description: Attach this instructor to the session (from GET /v1/platform/instructors), or `null` to take the instructor off it. Must be free at the time.

contactId.description: Reassign the booking to this contact (from GET /v1/platform/contacts). The outstanding charge, if any, moves with it.

amount.description: The booking's new price, before tax, in the club's currency - your own figure, kept as sent. Omit it to keep the price you recorded on a booking this API created, or to have a booking taken through 1club re-quoted by the club's pricing engine when the slot, area, instructor or contact changes. Cannot be set on a booking a membership covers.

recurrence.description: Make a one-off booking recur, or (with `scope=all_future`) rewrite the cadence or end condition of an existing series. The series starts at the booking's own start time, so there is no start date here. `daysOfWeek` is required for a weekly pattern, and a day repeated in it counts once. Not accepted on a booking an API key created.

daysOfWeek.description: For a weekly pattern, the days it runs on

endDate.description: Last date of the series, with `ends.type: until`

type.description: `until` runs to `endDate`, `after` runs for `occurrences` sessions, `never` extends on a rolling window

occurrences.description: With `after`: how many sessions the series holds, counted from its start

notifyCustomer.description: Tell the customer their booking changed - email with the updated calendar invite plus the in-app and WhatsApp notification. Only sent when the edit names a time, area, instructor or class. Off by default for an API key, on by default over an OAuth connection, as on create.

source.description: Channel that created the booking (api, admin, portal, app, kiosk, network, website, integration).

total.description: Total bookings matching the filters, ignoring pagination

percent.description: Null when the comparison period had none.

revenue.description: Recognised ex-tax, net of refunds and Wallet-funded parts.

collected.description: The part of it already paid, on the same basis.

previousRevenue.description: In the comparison period; absent without one.

timezone.description: The clock the days are read on.

byClub.description: Absent when the report is narrowed to one club.

byAccount.description: Which revenue account the money was filed to; a sale stored with no account counts as the default account. Absent when the report is narrowed to one account.

byPaymentMethod.description: What collected the money. A sale paid by several methods counts under the one that paid most; 'Unattributed' is collected with no real-money payment behind it.

topItems.description: What sold most: a class or court, a plan, a product.

movers.description: The streams, clubs and items whose revenue moved most against the comparison period, largest move first. Empty without a comparison.

PlatformUtilization.description: Percent of what there was to fill, one decimal: class seats taken, court and room hours booked, coach hours booked. Null when there was nothing to fill.

bookings.description: Bookings starting in the period and not cancelled: class seats, courts and rooms, sessions with a coach.

cancelledBookings.description: Bookings starting in the period that were cancelled.

checkins.description: Check-ins, on the day of the visit.

visitors.description: Distinct contacts with a booking counted in `bookings` or a check-in.

timezone.description: The clock the days are read on: the organization's timezone, as on the admin analytics dashboards.

byWeekday.description: The average day of each weekday in the period, Sunday first.

added.description: Created in the period, whatever became of them since, except a checkout still waiting for its first payment.

cancelled.description: Cancelled in the period, immediately or at the end of the paid period. A cancellation undone since is not counted.

activeAtEnd.description: At the end of the period, or now when it has not ended yet.

cancellationRate.description: Of those active at the start, the percent cancelled in the period. Null with none active.

timezone.description: The clock the days are read on: the organization's timezone, as on the admin analytics dashboards.

byPlan.description: The plans that moved most - added plus cancelled - largest first.

newCustomers.description: Contacts who became a Member or a Drop-in for the first time.

newMembers.description: Contacts who became a Member for the first time, a Drop-in taking their first membership included.

timezone.description: The clock the days are read on: the organization's timezone, as on the admin analytics dashboards.

members.description: Contacts holding a live recurring membership or season pass.

dropIns.description: Contacts holding a live pass or drop-in, or who visited in the last 30 days, without a membership.

byType.description: How many contacts hold each contact type: contact, lead, drop_in, member, lapsed.

trend.description: The counts at the end of each day or week.

lifecycle.description: Moves between contact types in the period. Null when the caller lacks `contacts:read`.

wonBack.description: A customer again after having lapsed.

churn.description: The period's churn, the admin Customer lifecycle report's: contacts whose recurring membership ended in the period with no other recurring membership following within the grace window, whatever the reason. Pass and drop-in holders lapse rather than churn, so they are `lifecycle.lapsed`, never counted here. Null when the caller lacks `contacts:read`.

churned.description: Contacts whose recurring membership ended in the period with nothing after it within the grace window. Includes a contact who joined and left within the period.

activeAtStart.description: Contacts holding a running recurring membership on the period's first day.

rate.description: Of the contacts active at the start, the percentage who churned in the period, to one decimal, so never above 100. Null when nobody was active at the start.

graceDays.description: Days after a membership's last covered day within which a following recurring membership keeps its holder from counting as churned.

historyFrom.description: The first day the membership status history covers, on the organization's clock: `reasons` and `frozen` count from it. Null when the organization has no history yet.

reasons.description: The churned contacts by why they left, one count per reason; a breakdown of `churned`, never a filter on it. Null when the period ended before the status history began, since the reason was never recorded. A period across that day breaks down only what ended since.

cancelled_by_member.description: The member chose to end it.

cancelled_by_staff.description: Staff ended it, changed it to an ended status while editing it, or cancelled its unpaid order.

cancelled_at_period_end.description: Cancelled for the end of its period, with no record of who chose it.

refunded.description: Its order was cancelled and the money that had settled went back.

expired.description: The term ran out: a membership that did not renew, with no cancellation behind it.

other.description: A platform flow ended it with no more specific cause, such as an archived contact.

unknown.description: A move nobody annotated with a reason.

frozen.description: Memberships that went into a freeze in the period. Null when the period ended before the status history began.

overview.description: What staff see on the contact's profile before serving them, present only with `include=overview`.

severity.description: The loudest alert; null when there is nothing to say.

alerts.description: Most pressing first. `kind` is one of archived, access_suspended, amount_due (`amount`), deposit_shortfall (`held`, `required`, `shortfall`), rental_overdue / rental_out (`rentals[]`), required_document_unsigned / optional_document_unsigned / required_field_missing (`requirements[]`). `amount_due` is raised when something has fallen due and is still unpaid, with the same figure as `money.amountDue`. Alerts inform; they never block a sale.

amountDue.description: What has fallen due and is still unpaid, as the profile shows it. Never reduced by Wallet credit.

upcomingAmountDue.description: Unpaid charges not fallen due yet: a booking whose visit has not started, or a charge whose due date is still ahead. Not part of `amountDue`.

transactions.description: Every transaction on the contact, void and reversal rows included.

activeMemberships.description: Plans still worth acting on, of any kind.

withheld.description: What was left out because the key lacks its scope.

PlatformContact.description: A contact (customer) in the organization. Reference the `id` as `contactId` when creating a booking.

uuid.description: Stable unguessable identifier. Prefer this over `id` when storing a reference.

type.description: Derived contact type (e.g. contact, member, lead). `archived` marks a retired contact — hidden from the list and from search, but still readable by id.

pipelineStageId.description: The sales pipeline stage the contact is in, or null when they are not in the pipeline.

pipelineLostReason.description: Why the lead was lost, while they are in the Lost stage. Null outside it, or when no reason was given.

pipelineLostNote.description: The note given with the lost reason.

assignedToId.description: The staff member (organization user id) following the contact up.

PlatformPipelineStage.description: A column of the sales pipeline. Open stages are where leads are worked; the one Lost stage (kind `cold`) holds leads that were lost, each with the reason it was given. A lead leaves the pipeline on its own when it pays for something.

isDefault.description: The stage new leads start in.

PlatformContactSource.description: Where contacts come from (a website form, a referral, a walk-in).

PlatformArchiveIncomplete.description: A 409 with code `ARCHIVE_INCOMPLETE`. The contact IS archived — only the release of what it held is unfinished. Repeat the same DELETE (the same `Idempotency-Key` is fine, a partial result is never replayed) to reconcile what is listed.

outstanding.description: What is still live on the archived contact.

id.description: The membership id, or the booking id for a booking or participation.

PlatformContactCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating a contact. At least one of `email` or `phone` is required so the person stays reachable and findable.

firstName.description: Given name. The display name is always recomputed from first + last.

email.description: Unique within the organization. Cannot be changed for a contact whose email is also their 1club login.

phone.description: Canonicalized to E.164 when the organization is configured for it.

pipelineStageId.description: Put the new contact in this sales pipeline stage (GET /v1/platform/pipeline-stages), which makes them a lead.

pipelineLostReason.description: Why the lead was lost. Only with a `pipelineStageId` naming the Lost stage (kind `cold`); sent with any other stage it is refused. Optional: a move to Lost without it reads as unknown. On a contact already in Lost it replaces the recorded reason.

pipelineLostNote.description: What the reason leaves out. Required when `pipelineLostReason` is `other`.

assignedToId.description: The staff member (organization user id) following the contact up.

PlatformContactUpdate.description: Fields accepted when updating a contact. Send only what changes; an omitted field is left alone, and `null` clears `lastName`, `email` or `phone`. At least one field is required, and the contact must keep at least one of `email` or `phone`. Clearing the family name stores it as an empty string rather than null, so a cleared `lastName` reads back as `""`.

firstName.description: Given name. The display name is always recomputed from first + last.

email.description: Unique within the organization. Cannot be changed for a contact whose email is also their 1club login.

phone.description: Canonicalized to E.164 when the organization is configured for it.

pipelineStageId.description: Move the contact to this sales pipeline stage (GET /v1/platform/pipeline-stages); null takes them out of the pipeline.

pipelineLostReason.description: Why the lead was lost. Only with a `pipelineStageId` naming the Lost stage (kind `cold`); sent with any other stage it is refused. Optional: a move to Lost without it reads as unknown. On a contact already in Lost it replaces the recorded reason.

pipelineLostNote.description: What the reason leaves out. Required when `pipelineLostReason` is `other`.

assignedToId.description: The staff member (organization user id) following the contact up.

total.description: Total contacts matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformInstructorSummary.description: An instructor (coach) in the organization, as returned by the instructors resource. Reference the `id` as `instructorId` when creating a booking. Leaner than the `PlatformInstructor` profile embedded in class payloads: this carries only what is needed to pick and price a coach.

name.description: Public display name when set, otherwise the linked contact name.

clubId.description: Club the instructor belongs to; null when org-wide.

instructorTypeId.description: The kind of coach, from GET /v1/platform/instructor-types; null for one nobody has filed.

hourlyRate.description: Added to the area price when pricing a booking with this instructor, unless `priceIncludesArea` is true.

priceIncludesArea.description: When true, `hourlyRate` is an all-in price that already covers the booked area - the area's price is not added on top of it.

bookability.description: Who may book one-to-one sessions with this instructor. `Admin_only` means the club reserves those bookings to its own staff, so a customer-initiated booking is rejected; an API key acts for the organization and may still create one. `No_one` means nobody may, an API key included: the instructor only teaches classes.

isBookable.description: Derived from `bookability`: true when it is `Member_only` or `Public`. Prefer `bookability`, which distinguishes members from the public.

maxPlayers.description: Read-only. Taken from the instructor type, where it is set (PATCH /v1/platform/instructor-types/{id}); sending it on an instructor create or update is refused with a 400. How many people one session with them may bring, the person booking included.

visibility.description: Who may see the instructor on member-facing surfaces. `bookability` never outruns it.

isActive.description: False for a retired instructor: hidden from the list by default, not bookable, history kept.

locations.description: Where a Professional (an independent instructor) teaches. Pass an `id` as `instructorLocationId` to schedule a class there. Empty for a coach at a club.

kind.description: `mobile`: the instructor travels to the client.

name.description: The gym or studio, for a `place`.

latitude.description: For `mobile`, the centre of the area served, rounded to about a kilometre.

radiusKm.description: For `mobile`, how far from the centre the instructor travels.

bufferMinutes.description: Minutes the instructor keeps free before a session here, to travel to it.

meetingUrl.description: For `online`, the link a client joins a session by.

PlatformInstructorCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating an instructor. Only `contactId` is required. Unknown fields are rejected, and `sendInvitation`, `organizationUserId`, `role`, `color` and `isBookable` are refused by name - this API creates a bookable coach and never a staff-portal user. `maxPlayers` is refused by name too: it is set on the instructor type.

contactId.description: The person, who must already be a contact in this organization. Not editable afterwards.

clubId.description: Club the instructor works at; null means every club in the organization.

instructorTypeId.description: The kind of coach, from GET /v1/platform/instructor-types. null leaves them unfiled, which is legal but loses the grouping every roster view reads from and the default revenue account their sessions would post to.

displayName.description: Public-facing name. Defaults to "<first name> <last initial>." from the contact.

hourlyRate.description: What a **member pays** for an hour of one-to-one time with them. Not what the club pays the coach - that is a pay rate policy. Added to the area price unless `priceIncludesArea` is true.

bookability.description: Who may book one-to-one sessions with them. `No_one` means nobody may, staff and API keys included: a coach who only teaches classes. Never outruns `visibility`: narrowing one pulls the other down with it, and deactivating the instructor retires this to `Admin_only` (a `No_one` coach stays `No_one`). The read-only `isBookable` is derived from this and cannot be written.

priceIncludesArea.description: When true, `hourlyRate` already covers the booked area, which is then not charged on top.

isActive.description: False retires the instructor: they leave the listings and stop being bookable, and their history is kept. There is no delete.

PlatformInstructorUpdate.description: Fields accepted when updating an instructor. Send only what changes; an omitted field is left alone. At least one field is required, and unknown fields are rejected. `contactId` is absent on purpose: re-pointing a profile at another person would transfer their bookings and pay. `maxPlayers` is refused by name: it is set on the instructor type.

clubId.description: Club the instructor works at; null means every club in the organization.

instructorTypeId.description: The kind of coach, from GET /v1/platform/instructor-types. null leaves them unfiled, which is legal but loses the grouping every roster view reads from and the default revenue account their sessions would post to.

displayName.description: Public-facing name. Defaults to "<first name> <last initial>." from the contact.

hourlyRate.description: What a **member pays** for an hour of one-to-one time with them. Not what the club pays the coach - that is a pay rate policy. Added to the area price unless `priceIncludesArea` is true.

bookability.description: Who may book one-to-one sessions with them. `No_one` means nobody may, staff and API keys included: a coach who only teaches classes. Never outruns `visibility`: narrowing one pulls the other down with it, and deactivating the instructor retires this to `Admin_only` (a `No_one` coach stays `No_one`). The read-only `isBookable` is derived from this and cannot be written.

priceIncludesArea.description: When true, `hourlyRate` already covers the booked area, which is then not charged on top.

isActive.description: False retires the instructor: they leave the listings and stop being bookable, and their history is kept. There is no delete.

total.description: Total instructors matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformFormQuestion.description: One question on a fill-in form, as read. Resend it with its `id` to keep it.

id.description: Keep this: answers are stored against it.

sectionHeading.description: Starts a new section above this question.

contactCustomFieldId.description: A member profile field this question's answer is also saved to, linked in the admin portal. Send it back unchanged (or leave it out) to keep the link, or null to remove it.

id.description: An existing question of this form, to keep it. Leave out for a new question.

required.description: Whether it must be answered. Always sent: there is no default.

options.description: Required for `select`. Not translatable: the choice is also the stored answer.

PlatformMembership.description: A customer's membership on a plan. The plan is snapshotted onto it at creation, so allowance and coverage behave exactly as they do for a membership sold in 1club.

membershipUuid.description: Stable unguessable identifier. Prefer this over `membershipId` when storing a reference.

clubId.description: Club the membership is limited to; null when it applies organization-wide.

status.description: active, paused, cancelled, expired, used, pending, or pending_payment

maxUses.description: Session allowance snapshotted from the plan; null when unlimited. With several `allowances`, their total.

usesRemaining.description: Sessions left; with several `allowances`, their total.

usesAdjustment.description: Sessions staff gave (or took back) this allowance period, on top of maxUses. Why usesRemaining can exceed maxUses.

allowances.description: Its session counters: one for an ordinary membership, several for one sold from a plan like 5 Yoga + 4 Pilates, each with its own balance.

allowanceId.description: Null on a membership with one allowance.

commitmentEndsAt.description: When the member's minimum commitment is met - they cannot cancel online before it; null for none. Counted from the start date and pushed out by pauses.

commitmentMonths.description: The term agreed, in months; null when there is none.

total.description: Total memberships matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformPlan.description: A membership plan. It carries its own price, joining fee, billing frequency and session allowance, so creating a membership only has to name the plan and the customer.

clubId.description: Club the plan is limited to; null when organization-wide.

seasonId.description: Set when the plan sells a season, and the marker that it is **not** for sale through this API: a season pass costs the sum of the slots the buyer picks, so the plan's own `price` is 0 and a membership created against it would put a member on a large contract for nothing. `GET /v1/platform/plans` excludes these; get-by-id resolves one so a membership already sold against it can be explained. Check it before treating any plan as sellable.

planCategoryId.description: Category the plan is grouped under on price lists; null when ungrouped.

revenueAccountId.description: Ledger account a sale posts to; null means the organization's default account is used at the time of the sale.

signupFee.description: Charged once when the membership starts, on top of the price.

isActive.description: False for a retired plan that is no longer sold.

maxUses.description: Session allowance a membership gets; null when unlimited. With several `allowances`, their total.

sessionUnit.description: What a use is counted in - a booking or an hour. Null when the plan has several `allowances`.

validityPeriod.description: Days the membership stays valid, when time-limited.

autoRenews.description: Whether a membership on this plan renews by default.

featured.description: Whether the club highlights this plan as "Most popular" on its price lists.

minimumTermMonths.description: Months a buyer commits to before the membership may end, counted from its start; null for none.

validFor.description: Booking resource scopes and optional type filters covered by the plan. Null when it has several `allowances`.

allowances.description: The plan's session counters: one for an ordinary plan, several for one like 5 Yoga + 4 Pilates a month. Their coverage never overlaps.

allowanceId.description: Null on a plan with one allowance, which lives on the plan itself.

maxUses.description: Sessions it grants each period; null when unlimited.

total.description: Total plans matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformProduct.description: A product the organization sells over the counter.

clubId.description: Club the product is sold at; null when available organization-wide.

categoryId.description: Product category it is grouped under.

sku.description: Stock-keeping code, if the gym uses one.

barcode.description: Scanned at the till. Unique across everything scannable in the organization.

price.description: What a customer pays, in the organization currency.

costPrice.description: What the gym pays for it; null when not tracked. Never shown to customers.

isActive.description: False for a product taken off the till without deleting its history.

visibility.description: Who may see it on customer-facing surfaces.

taxRateId.description: Per-product VAT rate; takes precedence over the revenue account default at the till.

total.description: Total products matching the filters, ignoring pagination

PlatformProductCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating a product. Only `name` and `price` are required; the defaults shown are what an omitted field becomes.

clubId.description: Limit the product to one club; null sells it everywhere.

sku.description: Stock-keeping code. Scannable at the till, so it must be unused by any other product, package, plan or access card in the organization.

barcode.description: Must be unused by any other product, package, plan or access card in the organization.

images.description: Replaces the whole list. Use already-hosted URLs.

areaTypeId.description: The kind of area, from GET /v1/platform/area-types. Decides `sports` and the default price.

status.description: Only an `active` area is bookable, and only those appear in the list. The other two resolve by id.

visibility.description: The list shows only `Public` areas; the others resolve by id.

sports.description: Sports the area is bookable for, from its area type.

maxConcurrentBookings.description: Bookings and classes the area holds at once; 0 means unlimited.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the operating hours are expressed in (the club's, falling back to the organization's). Convert a local wall time in this zone when sending `startTime`/`endTime` to POST /v1/platform/bookings.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the club's Default Area. At most one per club; a club may have none.

images.description: The area's photos, in display order.

PlatformAreaCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating an area. The defaults shown are what an omitted field becomes. Unknown fields are rejected.

areaTypeId.description: From GET /v1/platform/area-types. Decides which sports the area is bookable for and what it is priced from, so resolve it rather than guessing.

status.description: Only an `active` area is bookable. `maintenance` and `inactive` take it out of availability without losing its history - this is how a court is closed indefinitely, where an area block closes it for a stated window.

pricePerHour.description: Overrides the area type's default hourly price; null falls back to it.

operatingHours.description: Per-day-of-week opening schedule, in the club's timezone. Intersected with the club's own hours - an area is never bookable outside them.

maxConcurrentBookings.description: How many bookings and classes may hold the area at the same time. 1 for an ordinary court; 0 means unlimited (an open gym floor) and is the default for an area with no type.

isDefault.description: Make this the club's Default Area - the door-access area a check-in on a General Plan uses when the club has several active areas. `true` moves the flag off the club's previous default; `false` leaves the club with none.

images.description: The area's photos, shown on its website page and booking calendar. Absolute http(s) URLs, ideally from GET /v1/platform/media. Replaces the whole list.

clubId.description: Club the area belongs to, from GET /v1/platform/clubs. Not editable afterwards.

At least one field is required, and unknown fields are rejected. `clubId` is absent on purpose - moving a court to another club would strand its bookings, class holds and blocks at the old one.

slug.description: Stable key, derived from the name when a create does not send one. A rename never moves it.

sortOrder.description: Position in the order staff set in Settings, 1 first. Lists come back in this order; change it with the type's PUT .../order.

revenueAccountId.description: Where a booking on this kind of area posts. Null falls back to the organization's default account.

areaCount.description: Areas currently of this type, whatever their status.

sports.description: Sports an area of this type can be booked for.

isBookable.description: False for a type that is not booked at all (a storeroom, a corridor). Do not build bookable inventory on one.

defaultPricePerHour.description: Hourly price an area of this type starts from; an area may override it.

defaultMaxPlayers.description: How many people a slot on this type normally takes.

allowsSingles.description: Whether a booking on this type may be made for singles (2 players) instead of doubles. Only read when defaultMaxPlayers is 4; leave it off for padel.

maxConcurrentBookings.description: How many bookings and classes may hold an area of this type at once. 1 for an ordinary court; 0 means unlimited.

slug.description: Stable key. Derived from the name when omitted; send one only when something outside 1club already refers to it. An explicit slug that clashes is a 409, and a rename never moves it.

revenueAccountId.description: Where a booking on this kind of area posts, from GET /v1/platform/revenue-accounts. Leave it unset and the sale posts to whichever account the organization has marked default, resolved at the time of the sale.

sports.description: Canonical sport ids an area of this type can be booked for, e.g. ["padel"]. This is what makes the areas bookable for a sport at all; an unrecognised value is rejected rather than stored.

isBookable.description: False for a kind of space that is not booked at all (a storeroom, a corridor).

defaultPricePerHour.description: Hourly price an area of this type starts from. An area may override it.

defaultMaxPlayers.description: How many people a slot on this type normally takes.

allowsSingles.description: Whether a booking on this type may be made for singles (2 players) instead of doubles. Only read when defaultMaxPlayers is 4; leave it off for padel.

maxConcurrentBookings.description: How many bookings and classes may hold an area of this type at once, and what a new area of the type starts with. 1 for an ordinary court; 0 means unlimited.

revenueAccountId.description: Where a sale on this kind of class posts, from GET /v1/platform/revenue-accounts. Leave it unset and the sale posts to whichever account the organization has marked default, resolved at the time of the sale.

maxPartySize.description: How many people one booking may bring, including the booker.

allowMultiDay.description: Whether a class of this kind may run across more than one calendar day.

cancelIfAttendanceZero.description: Whether a class with nobody booked cancels itself.

cancelIfAttendanceZeroHoursInAdvance.description: Hours before the start that cancellation runs. Meaningless unless `cancelIfAttendanceZero`.

sport.description: The sport classes of this kind are for, a canonical sport id such as "jiu-jitsu". A default only: each class still carries its own `sport`. An unrecognised value is rejected.

ageGroups.description: Who a class of this kind is for: every age band it suits (baby 0–2, preschool 3–5, child 6–9, preteen 10–12, junior 13–17, adult 18–64, senior 65+), the same bands the age smart tags use. Stored youngest first, each once; a class for every age lists all of them, and an empty list means the club has not said. Marketplace search filters on it.

ageGroup.description: Deprecated - use `ageGroups`. The single age group from before a class type could name several bands, kept for one release. Read: the old value that names exactly `ageGroups` (`infant` is baby and preschool, `child` is child and preteen, `all_ages` is every band), else null. Write: read only when `ageGroups` is absent, mapped the same way, null clearing. Sending back the value a read reported changes nothing, and it never replaces bands no old value names - set those with `ageGroups`.

difficulty.description: How hard a class of this kind is. Marketplace search filters on it. Not a rank: see `programId`.

programId.description: The program this kind of class belongs to, from GET /v1/platform/programs. Its sessions count toward the program's progression track. Plans cover class types, not programs, so moving a class type between programs changes no plan.

progressionTrackId.description: Deprecated: set `programId` instead; the track a class type counts toward is its program's. Still accepted when `programId` is absent: a track puts the class type in the organization's one program counting toward that track (400 when none or several do), and null takes it out of its program.

revenueAccountId.description: Where a sale on this kind of class posts, from GET /v1/platform/revenue-accounts. Leave it unset and the sale posts to whichever account the organization has marked default, resolved at the time of the sale.

maxPartySize.description: How many people one booking may bring, including the booker.

allowMultiDay.description: Whether a class of this kind may run across more than one calendar day.
